Class ShadowProject

java.lang.Object
ca.phon.project.AbstractProject
ca.phon.project.LocalProject
ca.phon.app.project.ShadowProject
All Implemented Interfaces:
IExtendable, MutableProject, Project, ProjectDeprecated, ProjectEvents, ProjectMediaFolders, ProjectPaths, ProjectRefresh, ProjectResources, SessionDetails, SessionTemplate
public final class ShadowProject extends LocalProject
Shadow projects are used as temporary projects with the same data and properties as a delegate project. This is useful when running queries where some temporary files are stored inside the project folder.
